target: Chess puzzle and full-match benchmark replay

projectCheck.command: pnpm typecheck; pnpm build; bash evals/chess-smoke.sh; openspec validate add-chess-specialist-benchmark --strict

findings.note: Geist is intentionally preserved from the existing 2048 benchmark so the archive remains one visual system.

browserReview.note: Puzzle/model switching, match selection, move-history buttons, next-decision playback, arrow-key tabs, prompt-to-board FEN parity, responsive layouts, and downloadable evidence were reviewed.

ownerFeedback.note: Owner explicitly asked for a chess surface similar to the 2048 version and delegated the build-and-test pass.
